skill.name: roi-calculator
skill.description: Calculates influencer campaign ROI, ROAS, earned media value, cost efficiency, attribution scenarios, and lifetime value impact from supplied campaign data.
skill.summary: Measure influencer campaign returns with transparent formulas, assumptions, comparisons, and recommendations.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, code fences, placeholders, and ordinary marketing terms. Three findings confirm one underlying behavior: the skill uses shell substitution and invokes a repository-local Python scoring script.

remediation.issue: The repository-root fallback can select scripts from the current project instead of a trusted skill installation.
remediation.suggestion: Require a validated plugin root and stop when it is unavailable instead of falling back to the current Git repository.

remediation.issue: The optional C3 workflow invokes a local Python scorer.
remediation.suggestion: Request execution approval, verify the resolved script is inside the trusted installation, and pass validated file arguments without shell interpolation.

content.value_statement: Campaign teams often lack a consistent way to connect influencer spend with revenue, media value, and customer outcomes. This skill applies transparent formulas and records assumptions, evidence gaps, comparisons, and practical recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Calculates profit, direct ROI, and ROAS from supplied investment and revenue.
Estimates impression-based and engagement-based earned media value with declared rates.
Calculates CPM, CPR, CPE, CPV, CPC, CPA, and CAC when required inputs exist.
Compares first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution scenarios.
Projects lifetime value impact and ranks returns by influencer or influencer tier.
Produces a concise summary with formulas, assumptions, evidence gaps, and recommendations.
limitations: Results depend on the accuracy and attribution quality of supplied campaign data.
Earned media value and lifetime value outputs are estimates, not guaranteed financial returns.
External benchmarks require compatible sources, dates, markets, windows, currencies, and attribution definitions.
Typed C3 scoring requires trusted repository scripts and related skill outputs that may be unavailable.

use_cases.title: Defend Marketing Investment

use_cases.title: Compare Creator Value
use_cases.description: Rank creators and tiers by revenue return, budget share, and investment efficiency.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate Direct Return
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate direct ROI and ROAS for [campaign]. Spend was [amount], attributed revenue was [amount], and the reporting period was [dates]. Show every formula.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with verified spend and revenue totals.

prompt_templates.title: Measure Media Efficiency
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate CPM, CPE, CPC, CPA, and EMV for [campaign]. Use these results: [metrics]. Use only these declared comparison rates: [rates and sources].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Attribution Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Model campaign revenue using first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution. Use this journey data: [touchpoints]. Explain the recommended model.
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess returns across a multi-touch customer journey.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete ROI Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [campaign] using direct ROI, EMV, attribution, LTV, and creator-level returns. Mark missing evidence and incompatible benchmarks. Provide three decision-ready recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an advanced assessment for planning and executive review.

output_examples.input: Campaign spend was $25,000 and attributed revenue was $72,000.
output_examples.output: Profit is $47,000. Direct ROI is 188%, and ROAS is 2.88 to 1. The campaign is profitable on the supplied attribution basis.

output_examples.input: Campaign spend was $18,000, impressions were 1,500,000, and the declared comparable CPM was $8.
output_examples.output: Impression-based earned media value is $12,000. The EMV multiple is 0.67. Treat this estimate as directional because it uses a declared media rate.

output_examples.input: Three creators generated $40,000, $22,000, and $8,000 from fees of $10,000, $8,000, and $5,000.
output_examples.output: Creator one leads with 300% ROI. Creator two returns 175%, and creator three returns 60%. Review attribution quality before reallocating budget.

best_practices: Include every campaign cost and state the currency, reporting window, and attribution basis.
Provide source-dated comparison targets with compatible markets, cohorts, and cost definitions.
Separate direct revenue, estimated media value, and projected lifetime value in every conclusion.
anti_patterns: Do not combine earned media value with direct revenue as if both were collected cash.
Do not claim benchmark outperformance when the source or comparison basis is missing.
Do not project lifetime value without documented customer counts, value assumptions, and time horizons.

faq.question: What data do I need for direct ROI?
faq.answer: Provide total campaign investment and attributed revenue. Include the currency, reporting period, attribution model, and revenue source.

faq.question: Can the skill work without integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. You can supply campaign costs and results manually. Missing fields remain unknown rather than being invented.

faq.question: How is ROAS different from ROI?
faq.answer: ROAS divides revenue by spend. ROI subtracts investment from revenue before dividing by investment.

faq.question: Is earned media value the same as revenue?
faq.answer: No. Earned media value estimates comparable media cost. It should remain separate from direct or attributed revenue.

faq.question: Can it compare creators or channels?
faq.answer: Yes. Comparisons require normalized costs, currencies, observation windows, attribution rules, and compatible performance data.

faq.question: Does it create a full presentation?
faq.answer: No. It produces calculation tables and a concise summary. A separate reporting workflow can format a full presentation.
